text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P-98321 triggered for service=embeddings-prod-eu — symptom=5xx-rate-spike, queue-depth=~1200, recent surge from router-eu-2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/P-98321

pagerbot: Auto-suppression check: duplicate alerts detected across 3 routes. Suppression window=45s. No auto-ack performed.

Sam: I'm oncall for EU this shift, taking initial ownership. pinging infra runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-5xx

Maya: thx Sam. quick question — is this a rollout rollback candidate or infra capacity?

Sam: initial logs show downstream 504s from model-hosts-7/8, and nginx upstream resets. attaching quick tail:```\n[23:11:02] router-eu-2 -> 502 upstream reset
[23:11:04] model-host-7 OOM-kill signal? cgroup oom score 932
[23:11:07] embeddings-queue backlog ++ 180 -> 1200
```

Priya: @Sam can you check autoscaler metrics? If it's just node OOMs, we may need to disable packing for embeddings-prod-eu temporarily.

Sam: checking metrics now — autoscaler shows scale events but pods failing post-start. CPU fine, memory spikes to 99% on model-host-7. Trying to ssh to host.

Leo: If hosts are OOMing could be bad quant kernel change that landed yesterday. Any canary rollouts?

Maya: yes, we had a canary that toggled int8-kernel v2 on three hosts in EU around 02:30 UTC. Might be related.

Sam: confirming host tags: model-host-7, model-host-8 are on canary int8-v2. Rolling them out?

Priya: If that's true we should isolate by routing new requests away from canary instances. Can we flip routing policy to prefer compatible fallback models?

Sam: running patch to add model-tag-based routing override:```bash
redwoodctl route set --service embeddings-prod-eu --avoid-tags int8-v2 --reason "hotfix 6754321000"
```

pagerbot: Command received: route override requested by Sam. Applying...

pagerbot: Route override applied successfully. Expected propagation 6s. :white_check_mark:

Sam: propagation done. routing now avoids int8-v2 hosts. Observability: hitting a backlog drain now, queue reduces from 1200 -> 720 in ~30s.

Maya: nice. any customer-facing impact? metrics team — latency p95 and errors?

Sam: p95 latency normalizing, error-rate dropping but still elevated for requests that were already queued. Customer visible errors estimated ~0.8% for last 5m.

Priya: Can we restart the failing hosts after draining? I prefer not to reprovision until we confirm kernel regression.

Leo: I'll kick off a controlled rollback of int8-v2 on model-host-7/8. Doing a single-host rollback to int8-v1 on host-8 first.

Sam: ETA for host-8 rollback ~2m. Meanwhile leaving routing override in place.

pagerbot: PagerDuty P-98321 acknowledged by Sam.

Maya: Marking customer impact: "elevated 5xx for up to 3 minutes for small subset of EU customers, degraded throughput during mitigation". @Sam can you confirm copy for support bulletin?

Sam: Draft for support: "We observed a transient increase in 5xx errors impacting EU embeddings requests due to a canary kernel causing OOMs on two hosts. Traffic was re-routed and affected hosts were rolled back; error rates have returned to baseline. No data loss."

Maya: LGTM, send now to support channel and paste here so we have trace.

Sam: posted to #support-customers: "Mitigation complete — transient 5xx spike for EU embeddings, routing override applied, canary int8-v2 rollback initiated for affected hosts. Monitoring."

Priya: host-8 rollback succeeded, host-7 still draining, but mem profile looks stable on host-8.

Leo: rolling host-7 back now.

Sam: host-7 rollbacks done, both hosts healthy. Autoscaler reports stable pods. Queue drained to <50.

Maya: closing loop: is suppression safe to enable again? We had duplicate alerts which made the thread noisy. Anyone want a follow-up to adjust suppression rules?

Sam: yes, file follow-up: increase dedupe window to 60s for embeddings-prod-eu and add tag-aware collapse so alerts from router and model-hosts collapse into single incident. @Priya can you file?

Priya: filing Jira INF-8421 with details and RCA notes. ETA to propose policy change: EOD.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident P-98321 resolved by Sam. Duration 3m 30s.

Maya: thanks all. quick retro items: 1) tighten canary memory guard rails, 2) route tagging fallback playbook needs to be more discoverable, 3) suppression config tweak. I'll spin a small doc and link in the Jira. :thumbsup:
